Rottier. General Andy Strauss was a prospector who lived a self-sufficient life on the Salmon River. He is known for wearing few, if any clothes, which earned him the moniker of the "Naked Man of the River." He was more commonly called, "Andy the Russian," a reference to his birthplace.
